problem: In the school workshop. Choose the observation that supplies child A's argument. Requested source: green triangle. Input binding assigns the required source to child A's argument. Name the source and its role. Worked demonstration, separate from practice. Demonstration slot 0: green triangle. Demonstration slot 1: amber circle. Demonstration slot 2: violet star. Demonstration request: green triangle. Worked demonstration answer: BIND0. Match the request tag to its marked source; that demonstration slot supplies A's argument. Removing that source leaves no valid choice; substituting another tag breaks the match. Changing workplace alone changes nothing. End demonstration. Apply the same rule to the actual observations, whose slot order can differ. Your training target concerns those actual observations.
